title: App Store header (iOS 27), D: Colour story
brief: Direction D of the iOS 27 App Store header (21:9, 3840 × 1646) and search card (3:2): her wardrobe by colour. The founder 2026-10-24 asked for 'a bit more colorful', then on the colourful cut: 'feeling cheap… the colours please subtle colours'. So the hand-in is quiet and tonal (oat, sand, blush, sage, dusty blue, stone, pushed toward Mist), one hero at a time, a lot of air, soft real shadows: d1 dollies through six tonal rooms and ends on a palette of six tiles beside her real Wardrobe (build 284, silver iPhone); d2 brings one hero at a time onto a tonal sweep, each stepping aside into a row, then the six stand on their colour chips beside her real Wardrobe. The loud first cut is kept as versions: d1-bold (rich colour rooms) and d2-bold (the colour carousel). 15 s muted loops.
hook: 0–2 s: the cream room (or the carousel) lit and full of her own clothes; 'Your wardrobe, in every colour.' at 0.55 s.
